resources.string: A secure, non-custodial wallet for a borderless world. Manage, swap and grow your crypto — all in one place.
By continuing you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
Your assets, protected with industry-leading security.
Manage, send and receive crypto on supported networks.
Your crypto, on your terms.\nAnywhere in the world.
Set up your wallet in a few simple steps.
Use your seed phrase or private key
This build does not support connecting Ledger, Trezor or other hardware wallets. Never enter your hardware wallet recovery phrase to simulate a connection.
Write down these %1$d words in order and keep them safe. Never share them with anyone.

These words belong to your existing wallet. Changing them would create a different wallet, not change this account. To use a new phrase, create a separate wallet and transfer your assets securely. Your current words have not changed.
This account does not have a recovery phrase to display.
Your additional passphrase is required for recovery. Write it down separately as well.
Tap the words in the correct order.
All words selected. Confirm your backup.
Choose how you want to unlock Veldigo.
A custom password is not implemented in this wallet. Use the existing six-digit PIN or device-supported biometric authentication. Do not enter wallet secrets into a simulated password form.
Set a six-digit PIN before enabling biometric unlock. Fingerprint or face authentication requires a secure device and confirmation through Android. Never share your PIN or recovery phrase.
This device does not support the biometric authentication required by Veldigo. You can protect your wallet with the existing PIN setup.
Use your fingerprint to quickly and securely access Veldigo.
Verify identity to enable biometric unlock
Turn on a secure device screen lock before enabling biometric unlock. Your wallet PIN is also required.
Biometric authentication is unavailable or not enrolled on this device. Set up a supported fingerprint or face credential in Android settings, then try again.
Android could not verify your identity. Biometric unlock remains disabled. You can retry or use your existing PIN.
This version does not provide a verified fiat-to-crypto purchase integration. No payment has been started. You can use supported send, receive and swap features.
NFT holdings are not yet connected to this portfolio view. This does not mean your account has no NFTs.
Live price chart is unavailable for this asset.
Verified market description is not available for this asset.
Scan or select recipient QR address
Verify this address carefully before continuing.
QR code for your %1$s receiving address or payment request
Receiving address is unavailable. Check wallet synchronization.
Waiting for a live exchange quote
You can review and adjust the supported slippage tolerance on the transaction confirmation screen, after a live provider quote has been calculated. No slippage percentage is assumed here.
Fiat conversion unavailable — no purchase provider connected.
Card purchases and sales are not available in this version. No payment method or verified fiat on-ramp provider is connected. No money has been charged and no trade has been submitted.
Enter a positive amount with at most two decimal places.
No matching coins in the current top 100. Use full market search to find additional assets.
Load your Ethereum NFT gallery? This shares your public receiving address with the existing NFT metadata provider. No private keys or recovery phrase are sent.
NFT discovery currently supports Ethereum accounts only. No supported Ethereum wallet is enabled for the selected account.
Your Ethereum wallet address is not available yet. Check network and account synchronization, then retry.
The NFT metadata provider could not return your collection. Please try again later. This does not mean that your account has no NFTs.
The active wallet has changed. Reload this gallery before viewing account-specific results.
The metadata provider did not report any Ethereum NFTs for this address. Ownership and other networks are not independently verified here.
Provider-reported Ethereum NFTs; on-chain ownership is not independently verified. Never interact with unsolicited assets.
Create a wallet with a new recovery phrase
Recover using your phrase, key or backup file
Track a wallet address without signing keys
Give your wallet a name, then securely create your recovery phrase.
Choose the recovery phrase length or add an optional BIP39 passphrase
An optional BIP39 passphrase changes the wallet keys. Keep it with your backup: losing it may permanently prevent recovery.
Your recovery phrase is shown after the wallet is created. Write it down offline, verify it, and never share it with anyone.
Choose a wallet to manage its backup
PIN and biometric unlock are enabled
Protect your wallet access with a six-digit PIN
A six-digit app PIN is not configured
Requires app PIN and Android authentication
A separate emergency PIN is configured
Set a separate emergency PIN for the supported protection flow
Authenticate before removing the emergency PIN
Requires authentication; disables biometric wallet unlock too
Protect your recovery phrase offline. Review addresses and network details before sending crypto. These controls protect access to this app, not your blockchain transactions from every possible risk.
Disabling your app PIN also disables biometric wallet unlock. Authenticate to confirm this security change.
This removes the separate emergency PIN. Authenticate to confirm this change.
Control optional usage data and how the wallet connects to its networks. Your blockchain transfers remain public on their respective networks.
Manage PIN, biometrics, auto-lock and hidden balances

Tor can obscure some network metadata but does not make public blockchain activity anonymous. Network behavior varies by supported chain. Never enter your recovery phrase on websites or share it with others.

Tor is optional. Changing this setting restarts the app and may require you to unlock again. A selected Tor setting does not guarantee that every chain connection is currently established through Tor.
Enable Tor and restart the app? Connection setup can take time. Your normal app PIN or biometric unlock may be required again.
Disable Tor and restart the app? The wallet will stop using the configured Tor proxy. Your normal app PIN or biometric unlock may be required again.
Review the synchronization source for each supported network. Select a network to manage its actual connection settings.
No configurable blockchain networks are available.
Select a provider used to synchronize this blockchain. The selected source is not a guarantee of a currently working connection.
RPC providers can see requests and may return misleading blockchain data. Only use endpoints you trust; confirm transactions and balances independently.
Remove the custom provider “%1$s”? This does not delete the blockchain or your wallet.
Enter a secure RPC URL for this blockchain. Supported URL schemes are HTTPS and WSS, or HTTP for a valid Tor .onion host.
Do not put usernames or passwords into the URL. Private API keys in URL paths or parameters are never displayed in the provider list.
Credentials are masked on screen but are still saved by the existing node configuration storage. Use a trusted endpoint.
A custom RPC is an external service. It can observe requests and may provide incorrect results. Network privacy and endpoint reliability need independent verification.
Test the selected RPC before saving. On supported HTTPS networks, we check the reported chain ID without sending your wallet address or recovery phrase.
The RPC responded with the expected network chain ID. This does not guarantee that the provider is trustworthy.
Wrong network! This endpoint reports a different chain ID and cannot be saved for this blockchain.
The RPC response is missing a valid chain ID. Network identity has not been verified.
Could not verify this endpoint. It may be offline, blocked, or unavailable.
Live testing was skipped while Tor is enabled to avoid exposing a direct connection outside the configured proxy.
This RPC protocol cannot be tested by the HTTPS checker. The address is not verified.
The expected chain ID is not available for this network in the checker. The provider is not verified.
Enter a valid HTTPS, WSS, or allowed Tor .onion endpoint.
To test Basic Auth, enter credentials in username:password form. The provider is not verified.
I understand this RPC could connect to the wrong or an untrusted network. Save without verification.
Choose a supported restore and synchronization method for this network. Available choices come from the wallet’s network manager.
No synchronization modes are available for this blockchain.
Synchronization sources can process public wallet addresses and transaction requests. A source choice does not guarantee private or anonymous access, and this screen does not configure custom nodes.
Changing the restore source can trigger a new scan or synchronization and may temporarily delay balances or transaction history. Continue with this supported source?
Your selected synchronization source has not been saved. Leave this screen without applying the change?
The synchronization source could not be saved. The selection has not been confirmed. Please retry.

Status comes from the active wallet adapters on this device. An adapter reporting synced does not independently prove full network integrity or guarantee your transactions are final. No wallet addresses, keys, or raw network errors are shown here.
There is no enabled wallet for this blockchain in your active account. Enable one to view real synchronization progress.
The wallet adapter has not finished initializing. Synchronization state will appear when it becomes available.
Tor is enabled but has not reported an established connection. This screen will not claim a network error before Tor is ready.
Wallet adapters are preparing or connecting. The current network status is not yet synchronized.
The existing blockchain adapter reports active synchronization. Progress is displayed only when that adapter provides a valid measurement.
The existing adapter is searching transactions. The count shown, when present, comes from its actual scan state.
All enabled wallets for this blockchain report synchronized adapters. This is a local status, not independent proof of chain integrity.
At least one active adapter reported an error. Retry when your network is available, or review your synchronization source. Detailed error text is hidden for privacy.
Automatic selection uses current node reachability measurements. Disable it to choose a specific node manually.
This removes the selected saved connection. Choose another node before removing a currently active node. Your Monero wallet and keys are not deleted.

Monero nodes may observe connection metadata and wallet network requests. A successful ping only measures recent reachability and is not proof that a node is trustworthy. Choose trusted nodes carefully; changing a node may restart wallet synchronization.
